question: Where was the Khelo India Ice Hockey Tournament held in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chiktan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In Kargil, Ladakh, Khelo India Ice Hockey Tournament is being organized at Chiktan from 6 January 2021.**
 
• For the first time,** the women team** of Chiktan also participated in the Khelo India Games in the Kargil district.
